lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately three parallel horizontal rows along the visible posterior lateral flank, maintaining regular inter-blob spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Transverse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, forming a lattice of high-luminance anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature with a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient—characterized by high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a sharp drop into shadow below—extends horizontally along the upper third of the posterior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin upper lobe displays a high-contrast pattern of discrete high-luminance spots organized along its longitudinal axis, visible despite surface water refraction.
